input:
1girl, solo, from above, dynamic foreshortening, looking up, confident smile, fang, flying, one hand making a two-finger sword command, other hand holding a black straight sword

A complete circular vortex of thirty beautiful flying swords surrounds the girl on ALL FOUR SIDES. The girl floats in the clear center of a large circular sword orbit. Each sword points tangentially along the clockwise circular path: top swords point right, right swords point down, bottom swords point left, left swords point up. Full closed ring, near circle seen from overhead, not a parallel rain of swords. Varied elegant long swords, thin jian, broad leaf blades, wave blades, crystalline swords, unique guards. Foreground swords large, distant swords smaller. The orbit stays clear of her face and hands.

Abstract slate gray-blue background, a thin cyan circular energy trail follows the swords, silver and black metal with restrained gold accents.

Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions.
